description: issue #681 (slice I2), the WORD half of the number-vs-word rule: `spec/interaction-events.md:197-198` — "Otherwise it returns a word preserving the entered text." The same program shape as `input-number-answer` with a non-numeral answer: "tom" is reported as the word `tom`, so `word "hello " :name` concatenates to `hello tom` and the identical `is a "number"` question reports `false` where its twin reports `true`. That shared question is what makes the two fixtures a discriminating PAIR rather than two runs of the same assertion: an implementation that never reports a number fails the number half (the always-number direction is vacuous, since "tom" cannot parse as a numeral). The concatenation line is also the spec's own worked example (`spec/interaction-events.md:200-203`).
